question: How can I make specific files or folders in a Files component stand out visually in my documentation?
ground_truth: You can make files or folders stand out visually by using the `highlighted` property, which adds an accent background color to the item. Additionally, you can use the `comment` property to add explanatory text next to the file or folder name. For example, `<File name="README.md" highlighted comment="Important file" />` will highlight the README.md file and add a comment next to it.

metadata.cited_context: Use the `highlighted` property to highlight specific files or folders with an accent background color. Use the `comment` property to add explanatory text that appears next to an item. These properties are useful for drawing attention to important files or providing additional context, similar to how code blocks support line highlighting and inline comments.
